clinicalSummary: Stillborn at 36 weeks following reported reduced fetal movements for three days. Mother booked, labour spontaneous and uncomplicated. Macerated stillbirth — cause undetermined pending perinatal review.

Early neonatal death on day 2 of life. Born at 37 weeks after prolonged labour; poor Apgar scores, required resuscitation and admitted to NICU where the baby deteriorated overnight. Perinatal death review initiated.

Elderly man living alone, found deceased by a neighbour after not being seen for two days. No known chronic illness on record and no signs of foul play. Sudden unexplained death — post-mortem requested.
Collapsed suddenly at a bus stop and was pulseless on arrival of ambulance crew; resuscitation unsuccessful. No prior medical history available. Death referred for post-mortem to establish cause.
Victim of a hit-and-run road traffic accident on the Mutare–Nyanga road; brought in by passers-by with severe head and chest injuries. Certified dead on arrival. Police investigation opened.

Recovered unresponsive from the Gweru River after reportedly swimming with friends. Prolonged submersion; resuscitation at the scene and in casualty unsuccessful. Drowning — circumstances under police investigation.
